mode.description: shadow = detect and audit only; enforce = apply intercept actions

mode.label: Enforcement mode
mode.help: shadow = detect + audit only (no intercept). enforce = replace tool result with [BLOCKED], inject LLM security alert, block follow-on tool calls in the same outer turn.

threats.promptInjection.label: Detect prompt injection
threats.promptInjection.help: Match tool results that try to rewrite the agent's instructions (ignore previous instructions / you are now / disregard / new persona).

threats.shellInjection.label: Detect shell injection
threats.shellInjection.help: Match tool results containing destructive shell commands (rm -rf, curl|bash, DROP TABLE, mkfs, fork bomb).

patterns.promptInjection.label: Custom prompt-injection patterns
patterns.promptInjection.help: Extra regex patterns appended to the built-in set. Invalid regexes are skipped with a warning.

patterns.shellInjection.label: Custom shell-injection patterns
patterns.shellInjection.help: Extra regex patterns appended to the built-in set. Invalid regexes are skipped with a warning.
